llmAnalysis.summary: Plugin is a comprehensive system monitor with no malicious behavior. The sole auto-flagged finding is a false positive, and all privileged operations (proc polling, GPU tools, process termination) require explicit user interaction or system auth via pkexec.
llmAnalysis.whatItDoes: Shows a bar widget with a pinned metric (CPU, memory, network, etc.) and a dashboard with 6 tiles, per-core CPU load, graphs, storage, GPU details and a sortable/filterable process list. Users can expand tiles, pin a metric to the bar, adjust polling interval, and terminate/force-kill processes after a confirmation dialog.
llmAnalysis.sequenceDiagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant BarWidget
    participant Panel
    participant System as System ProcFS/Tools
    participant Priv as pkexec
    User->>BarWidget: Click widget (toggle/middle-click refresh)
    BarWidget->>Panel: Loader source Qt.resolvedUrl("Panel.qml")
    Panel->>System: Poll cat /proc/stat,/proc/meminfo, sensors -j, lspci, df, ip, ss, nvidia-smi/intel_gpu_top
    System-->>Panel: parseCpu/Memory/Network/GPU -> update tiles, graphs, tooltip
    User->>Panel: Terminate/Force kill process (confirm dialog)
    Panel->>System: kill -TERM/-KILL <pid>
    Panel->>Priv: pkexec pacman/apt-get/dnf install intel-gpu-tools or setcap cap_perfmon (Intel GPU only)
    Priv-->>Panel: exit code -> finishIntelGpuSetup

findings.reasoning: Qt.resolvedUrl("Panel.qml") resolves an internal QML component for Loader.source, not a file URL for execution. Loader displays UI only; never passed to Process.command or execDetached.
findings.relatedCode: Loader { source: Qt.resolvedUrl("Panel.qml") } BarWidget.qml:61; onLoaded injectPanel() only wires bar/settings - no execution
findings.executableContext: Not an executable. Panel.qml is the plugin's own dashboard UI (imported as QML). No args, no sanitization needed; distinct from exec wrappers like mx-ctl/solaar.
